title: Microsoft Dataverse: Improved enterprise experiences in Power Platform - Enhance Dataverse record descriptions for Copilot /mention
description:
End users of Microsoft 365 Copilot will see improved Microsoft Dataverse, Dynamics 365, and Power Apps record references in Context IQ with richer, more descriptive labels that include environment, app, and table information. This makes it easier to identify and select the correct records during Copilot interactions.

Business Value:

Enables Microsoft 365 Copilot to surface business data with meaningful context, reducing confusion from generic labels and helping users quickly identify the right records to drive faster workflows and more reliable decision-making.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users
